description: Add an item to a module: Assignment, Page, Quiz, File, Discussion, ExternalUrl, ExternalTool or SubHeader. Returns the created module item, including its new Canvas ID. Each call adds a new item — calling it twice with the same title adds two items, not one. Which identifying field to pass depends on `type`: `page_url` for Page (addressed by slug, not ID), `content_id` for File, Discussion, Assignment or Quiz, `external_url` for ExternalUrl or ExternalTool, and neither for SubHeader. Use `list_module_items` to see what is already in the module, and `update_module_item` or `delete_module_item` to change or remove an item afterward. Requires instructor/TA permission to manage course content.

content_id.description: Canvas ID of the content (required for File, Discussion, Assignment, Quiz)

external_url.description: URL for ExternalUrl or ExternalTool items

page_url.description: Page URL slug (required for Page items, which are addressed by slug, not ID)

name: create_module_item
title: Create Module Item
